bug_fixed.issue: Internal Server Error when creating triggers
bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one() adds _id field to the dict, which is an ObjectId that cannot be JSON serialized
bug_fixed.fix: Added trigger_dict.pop('_id', None) before returning the response
